method: agent-enumerated from domain knowledge cross-checked against events/*.yaml; not from automated scraper
cross_check_method: Each candidate slug verified absent from events/*.yaml and candidate_triggers/*.yaml at generation time. Where similarly-named events exist, the rationale field notes the distinction.
exclusion_notes: OFAC SDN actions excluded except where they materially extend named-ransomware coverage already in S1; OFAC stratum is densely covered.
Tornado-cash developer cases (Pertsev, Storm, Semenov) already covered by pertsev-nl-arrest-2022, storm-semenov-doj-2023, semenov-ofac-2023 and not re-enumerated.

FTX as a target is split: SBF criminal trial enumerated as ftx-bankman-fried-doj-2022 (P0); SEC v. FTX civil enumerated as sec-v-ftx-2022 (P1). Bankruptcy court (Voyager/Celsius/BlockFi) actions enumerated as separate candidates because court is the legal actor.
Beaxy is already covered by sec-beaxy-platform-shutdown-2023 in current corpus, so not re-enumerated.
Welcome to Video 2019 included as Larry Harmon predates Helix but Welcome-to-Video is a separate operator (Son); both relevant.

candidates.target: Telegram Group Inc. + TON Issuer Inc. — unregistered offering of Gram (TON) tokens to public
candidates.one_line_rationale: Landmark SEC injunction halted the entire $1.7B TON Gram distribution before mainnet launch; foundational precedent for SAFT framework litigation and the most-cited token-distribution-blocked case before Ripple. Missing from corpus.

candidates.target: Ripple Labs Inc. + Brad Garlinghouse + Christian Larsen — alleged unregistered offering of XRP
candidates.one_line_rationale: Most-cited US securities case against a major token issuer; produced cascade of US CEX XRP delistings (Coinbase, Bitstamp, Binance.US, Kraken) within 4 weeks — cleanest observable offramp_cex cascade in the entire SEC stratum. Critical baseline absent.

candidates.target: Jong Woo Son operator of darknet site Welcome to Video; 337 users charged; 24 children rescued; BTC addresses traced via Chainalysis
candidates.one_line_rationale: Largest darknet CSAM site bitcoin takedown; coordinated IRS-CI/DOJ/HMRC/Korean NPA action; cleanest example of address-level traceability driving multi-country arrests. Cascade-rich and citable.

candidates.target: Samuel Bankman-Fried + FTX Trading Ltd. + Alameda Research — wire fraud, money laundering, campaign finance violations
candidates.one_line_rationale: Highest-profile US crypto exchange criminal indictment of the decade; conviction Nov 2023, sentenced Mar 2024; observable cascade through FTX.com geofencing, Alameda address freezes (Tether, Circle), and Chapter 11 freeze. Conspicuously absent.

candidates.target: Binance Holdings Ltd. + Changpeng Zhao + Samuel Lim — CEA willful evasion + unregistered futures/swaps
candidates.one_line_rationale: CFTC suit predates the 2023-11 4-framework DOJ resolution by 8 months and 2023-06 SEC case by 70 days; corpus has sec-v-binance and binance-4framework but is missing the CFTC civil component — essential to multi-agency timeline.

candidates.target: Genesis Global Capital LLC + Gemini Trust Co. LLC — unregistered offer/sale of crypto-lending Gemini Earn product
candidates.one_line_rationale: Major lending-product enforcement parallel to BlockFi 2022; Gemini Earn frozen Nov-2022 then formally charged Jan-2023, settled Feb-2024 for $21M + $1.1B in returned customer assets. Twin gap to existing blockfi-sec-lending-2022.

candidates.target: Bittrex Inc. + Bittrex Global GmbH + William Shihara — unregistered national securities exchange/broker/clearing agency
candidates.one_line_rationale: Bittrex announced US exit weeks before SEC suit and filed Chapter 11 May-2023; clean evidence of regulatory action driving full US-market exit; settled Aug-2023 for $24M.

candidates.target: Payward Inc. + Payward Ventures Inc. (Kraken) — unregistered securities exchange/broker/dealer/clearing agency
candidates.one_line_rationale: Distinct from kraken-sec-staking-2023 (Feb-2023 staking settlement); this is the Nov-2023 unregistered-exchange suit (later dismissed Mar-2025 under Atkins SEC). Important counter-data-point for the SEC retreat narrative.

candidates.target: Coinbase Global Inc. — Wells Notice covering listed assets + staking + Coinbase Wallet
candidates.one_line_rationale: Wells Notice predates the 2023-06-06 formal SEC complaint (sec-v-coinbase-2023) by 76 days; Coinbase pre-emptive disclosure (8-K Mar-2023) is an early-warning datapoint analogous to sec-v-uniswap-wells-notice-2024.

candidates.target: Roman Storm — partial guilty verdict on operating unlicensed money-transmitter count (sec § 1960); hung on other counts
candidates.one_line_rationale: Conviction phase of the Aug-2023 storm-semenov-doj-2023 case; key post-Tornado-OFAC-delisting datapoint that DOJ criminal track survived the OFAC retreat. Pairs with tornado-cash-ofac-delisting-2025.

candidates.target: Tether Holdings Limited + iFinex Inc. (Bitfinex) — false/misleading statements re: USDT reserves
candidates.one_line_rationale: $42.5M settlement; first major US federal action establishing USDT issuer accountability; foundational precedent for downstream tether-doj-pig-butchering-freeze-2023 and tether-retroactive-sweep-2023 events already in corpus.

candidates.target: HDR Global Trading Limited (BitMEX) — BSA AML willful violations consent assessment
candidates.one_line_rationale: $100M FinCEN civil penalty distinct from 2020 DOJ/CFTC actions (bitmex-cftc-doj-2020 in corpus); represents the FinCEN-specific BSA component completed years later — useful for multi-agency chronology.

candidates.target: iFinex + Tether — NY AG investigation settlement re: $850M loss + reserve misstatements
candidates.one_line_rationale: State-level rather than federal; included because NYAG anchors the federal-precursor narrative for cftc Tether 2021. P2 because actor is state not federal; flag for review whether scope window excludes state AG actions.

candidates.target: Voyager Digital Holdings Inc. — DOJ filed appeal blocking confirmation of Binance.US asset-sale plan
candidates.one_line_rationale: US Trustee/DOJ blocked $1.022B Binance.US deal; ultimately Voyager liquidated independently. Federal-court mediated cascade event affecting customer-asset return rails.

candidates.target: Alex Mashinsky + Celsius Network LLC — securities/wire/commodities fraud + market manipulation re: CEL token
candidates.one_line_rationale: Highest-profile crypto-lender criminal indictment alongside SBF; parallel SEC/CFTC/FTC actions same day; produced direct CEL token cascade and BTC/ETH withdrawal-freeze observable at Celsius custody addresses. Pleaded guilty Dec 2024.

candidates.target: Samuel Bankman-Fried + FTX Trading Ltd. + Alameda — civil fraud re: FTT token / Alameda
candidates.one_line_rationale: Parallel SEC civil filing same day as the DOJ criminal action (ftx-bankman-fried-doj-2022); represents the securities-law axis of the multi-agency FTX cascade.

candidates.target: FTX Trading Ltd. + Samuel Bankman-Fried + Alameda — CEA fraud violations
candidates.one_line_rationale: Third leg of the same-day DOJ/SEC/CFTC tri-charge against SBF; needed to complete the multi-agency cascade triangulation.

candidates.target: Larry Dean Harmon (Helix follow-on) — FinCEN $60M civil penalty (separate from DOJ helix-doj-mixer-2020)
candidates.one_line_rationale: FinCEN's first civil penalty against a mixer operator; civil-component of Helix already partially in corpus as helix-doj-mixer-2020; pairs with that as multi-agency follow-on.

candidates.target: Sinbad.io mixer infrastructure seizure (joint with Dutch FIOD / Finland NBI); successor to Blender.io
candidates.one_line_rationale: Existing sinbad-ofac-2023 is the OFAC SDN; missing the DOJ-led seizure-and-operator track; same domain takedown banner pattern as samourai-doj-2024. Joint international action.

candidates.target: Alexey Pertsev — US criminal indictment (parallel to Dutch case already in pertsev-nl-arrest-2022)
candidates.one_line_rationale: P2 because much of the substantive content overlaps with storm-semenov-doj-2023; verify whether the SDNY indictment of Pertsev is a separate document or part of the same Storm/Semenov filing; if separate, admit; if same, exclude.

candidates.target: Bittrex Inc. — FinCEN $29M concurrent OFAC penalty for BSA/sanctions failures
candidates.one_line_rationale: Joint FinCEN-OFAC $29M action 18 months before sec-v-bittrex-2023 and Chapter-11 filing; cleanest dual-agency exchange action documenting compliance failure cascade.

candidates.target: Binance Holdings Limited — FinCEN $3.4B BSA consent order + 5-yr monitorship
candidates.one_line_rationale: P2 because binance-4framework-2023 already captures the multi-agency settlement; this candidate is the FinCEN-only slice if the framework event proves to subsume — verify if explicit split is needed for the FinCEN monitorship clause specifically.

candidates.target: Ryan Salame (FTX Digital Markets co-CEO) — campaign-finance + unlicensed money transmitting plea
candidates.one_line_rationale: Co-defendant track adjacent to ftx-bankman-fried-doj-2022; P2 because evidence cascade overlaps with primary SBF event; include only if dataset structure rewards co-defendant granularity.

candidates.target: tornado.cash domain and GitHub repository — collateral L4 effects of OFAC SDN listing
candidates.one_line_rationale: L4 cascade companion to tornado-cash-ofac-2022 already in corpus; the GitHub repo takedown + Infura/Alchemy RPC blocking are well-documented but may already be coded as observations within the parent event. Verify before admission.
